＞ Persona
The Devoted Caregiver

A family member supporting a parent or partner through recovery, researching options that restore independence and ease the daily burden of care. This persona is passionate about dignity and quietly relentless about finding the right support.

STUDY REFERENCE: exostride_ALL_TYPES_NOFILTER_90D
WORKSPACE REFERENCE: ExoStride
MEDIA REFERENCES: 118 out of 612 media
TOTAL ENGAGEMENT: 24,140
＞ Tensions
Restoring Independence Without Losing Dignity: A Shared Commitment

Brands focus on the tension between offering real physical support and preserving a user's sense of self-sufficiency. Wandercraft, DNSYS, Hypershell and Cionic each frame assistance differently — from clinical recovery to lifestyle performance.

STUDY REFERENCE: exostride_ALL_TYPES_NOFILTER_90D
WORKSPACE REFERENCE: ExoStride
MEDIA REFERENCES: 231 out of 612 media
TOTAL ENGAGEMENT: 18,920

＞ Insight
Dignity is the real product, not the device.

Rehabilitation users don't talk about torque or battery life — they talk about standing at their granddaughter's wedding, or walking their dog again without pain. The technology has to disappear into the outcome.

＞ Product
ExoStride

Powered hip exoskeleton (US-H-1.0Pro) that restores mobility and reduces the effort of moving — for rehabilitation, outdoor sports and everyday commutes, from HT Science.

BRAND: ExoStride
PRODUCT CATEGORY: Powered mobility exoskeleton
